decks.notes: The main concept of this Selesnya Aggro deck is to quickly play low-cost creatures to apply early pressure on the opponent, while also using disruptive creatures like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Elite Spellbinder to slow down the opponent's game plan. Collected Company and Kayla's Reconstruction provide additional creature generation and card advantage. The deck aims to create a fast and aggressive board presence, overwhelming the opponent with a combination of efficient creatures and disruptive elements. The mana base is optimized to support the deck's color requirements and enable smooth gameplay.

The deck focuses on utilizing Transmogrify to cheat out powerful creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier or Ob Nixilis, the Adversary. The combo potential is further enhanced with cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Case of the Stashed Skeleton. The goal is to control the board with removal spells like Fatal Push and Torch the Tower while disrupting the opponent's hand with Thoughtseize and Duress. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional ramp and flexibility to the deck. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats.

The deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo involving Amalia Benavides Aguirre and Aetherflux Reservoir to gain a large amount of life and then use the reservoir to finish off the opponent in one shot. The deck includes several creatures and spells to help find and protect the combo pieces, as well as generate extra life gain along the way. The deck also includes a toolbox of cards such as Skyclave Apparition and Return to the Ranks to deal with various threats and situations.

This deck focuses on aggressive gameplay by utilizing efficient removal, disruption, and a mix of low-cost creatures to apply pressure to the opponent. It aims to control the board with removal spells like Fatal Push and disrupt the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize, while also hitting hard with creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Archfiend of the Dross. The inclusion of powerful planeswalkers like Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord can provide additional reach and close out games quickly. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent early and maintain pressure throughout the game.

This Pioneer 1 vs 1 deck focuses on utilizing the combo potential of cards like Spark Double, Clever Impersonator, and Greater Tanuki to create powerful interactions on the battlefield. By discovering the synergies between different cards in the deck, players can generate overwhelming board states and overwhelm their opponent with a mix of creatures and spells. The inclusion of Leyline Binding and Bedeck / Bedazzle also provide additional control and flexibility to adapt to different situations, making this deck a versatile and formidable force in the format.

The deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo utilizing Amalia Benavides Aguirre alongside cards like Collected Company and Chord of Calling to generate value and create a strong board presence. Cards like Aetherflux Reservoir and Glean the ruins are included to provide additional win conditions. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces while utilizing cards like Prosperous Innkeeper and Extraction Specialist to gain incremental advantage and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the deck is built around efficiently executing a powerful combo strategy while maintaining flexibility and resilience.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature spells such as Bloodtithe Harvester, Vein Ripper, and Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord. The deck also includes disruptive spells like Fatal Push, Duress, and Thoughtseize to disrupt opponent's game plan. The deck aims to pressure the opponent's life total quickly while controlling the board with removal spells and hand disruption. Overall, the deck's strategy revolves around early aggression backed up by disruption to maintain tempo and control throughout the game.

The deck focuses on aggressive plays with a mix of disruption and creature pressure, utilizing cards like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize to control the game early on. Bloodtithe Harvester and Vein Ripper are key creatures that can quickly end the game if left unchecked. Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord provides additional creature support and synergy with vampire creatures in the deck. Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse offer powerful late-game threats. The land base is designed for consistent mana sources to support the aggressive game plan.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through counter spells, removal, and card advantage. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan by countering their spells and removing their threats while drawing cards to maintain resource advantage. Additionally, the inclusion of Kaheera as a companion adds an extra layer of synergy and value to the deck. The mana base is designed to support the control elements of the deck, enabling the player to consistently cast their spells and control the game.

This deck focuses on using Niv-Mizzet Reborn as a powerful control finisher, with a mix of removal, card advantage, and multicolor spells to maximize his ability. The inclusion of Bring to Light allows for versatile tutoring, while Leyline Binding and other enchantments provide additional lockdown against opposing threats. The companion Yorion, Sky Nomad adds a flicker strategy for value and tempo advantage. Overall, this deck aims to grind out opponents with a combination of powerful threats and disruptive spells, ultimately overwhelming them with card advantage and board control.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly build up a strong board presence with green creatures and utilize devotion to green cards to generate massive amounts of mana. By ramping up mana production with cards like Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and Elvish Mystic, this deck can quickly play high-cost threats like Cavalier of Thorns and Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Storm the Festival to help search for key creatures and spells, making it a powerful aggro deck with a strong devotion to green theme.

The deck focuses on assembling a strong board presence through a combination of creatures with strong abilities and using Collected Company to quickly refill the board. The key strategy involves generating a significant amount of life gain through cards like Amalia Benavides Aguirre and Prosperous Innkeeper, while also maintaining a strong defense with creatures like Selfless Savior and Skyclave Apparition. The deck is designed to outlast opponent's threats and eventually win the game through the combo of Aetherflux Reservoir and a high life total, making it difficult for opponents to mount a comeback.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively play Arclight Phoenix cards and use spells like Fatal Push and Consider to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also includes card draw and control elements like Sleight of Hand and Thoughtseize to maintain tempo. Additionally, there are creatures like Picklock Prankster and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to apply pressure and close out the game quickly. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements while also providing flexibility in spell choices.

This deck focuses on aggressive gameplay, utilizing powerful creatures and removal spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. By combining efficient creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Archfiend of the Dross with disruptive spells like Duress and Thoughtseize, the deck aims to control the game while dealing continuous damage. Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord provides additional support for the creatures, allowing them to gain valuable abilities and advantages in combat. With a solid mana base and a mix of threats and answers, this deck aims to be a fast and relentless force on the battlefield.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive plays using powerful creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Vein Ripper, supported by disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push. The deck also includes cards like Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker for additional support and potential card advantage. With a mix of efficient removal, hand disruption, and strong creatures, this deck aims to apply pressure on opponents quickly and close out games before they have a chance to stabilize.

This deck focuses on using aggressive Azorius spirits to control the board and tempo of the game. By utilizing a mix of disruptive creatures like Mausoleum Wanderer and Spell Queller, combined with powerful spirits like Supreme Phantom and Skyclave Apparition, the deck aims to pressure the opponent while maintaining control. The inclusion of cards like No More Lies and Get Lost provide additional disruption and card advantage, allowing the deck to outmaneuver and overwhelm opponents. Ultimately, the deck seeks to quickly close out games using a combination of evasion and powerful spirit synergies.
